headword: {体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}

definitions.gloss: experiential learning; hands-on learning — education in which students learn by directly experiencing an activity
definitions.explanation: An educational approach in which students acquire knowledge and skills through direct, practical experience rather than only through lectures or textbooks. In Japan, it is widely used for elementary and junior high school field programs — farming experiences, workplace visits, traditional craft workshops, nature programs, and similar activities.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{農業|のうぎょう}の{体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}がある。
examples.english: Next month there will be a hands-on learning program in farming.

examples.japanese: {小学生|しょうがくせい}たちが{陶芸|とうげい}の{体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}を{楽|たの}しんでいた。
examples.english: The elementary school students were enjoying a hands-on learning activity in pottery.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{工場|こうじょう}を{訪問|ほうもん}する{体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}を{通|つう}じて、{生徒|せいと}たちはものづくりの{大変|たいへん}さを{知|し}ったそうだ。
examples.english: Through the hands-on learning program of visiting a local factory, the students apparently came to understand how demanding manufacturing work is.

notes:
Compound of {体験|たいけん} ('first-hand experience') and {学習|がくしゅう} ('learning; study'). Emphasizes gaining knowledge by doing rather than by reading or listening.

USAGE:
- Very common in school curricula. Public elementary and junior high schools regularly organize {体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう} in cooperation with local farms, factories, traditional-craft studios, and civic facilities.
- Adult learning contexts also use the word for workshops, trial lessons, and corporate training that involve a practical component.
- Overlaps with {体験|たいけん}{授業|じゅぎょう} ('trial/experience class'), but {体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう} focuses on the learning process while {体験|たいけん}{授業|じゅぎょう} typically refers to a sample lesson used to introduce prospective students to a school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct experiential learning
- {体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in experiential learning
- {農業|のうぎょう}{体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}: farming experience program
- {職場|しょくば}{体験学習|たいけんがくしゅう}: workplace experience program

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体験|たいけん}{授業|じゅぎょう}: trial lesson — sample class for prospective students.
- {実習|じっしゅう}: practical training; practicum — usually tied to vocational or professional training with specific skill goals.
- {校外学習|こうがいがくしゅう}: off-campus learning — broader term for lessons held outside school grounds.
- {見学|けんがく}: observational tour — visiting a facility mainly to look, with less hands-on participation.
